description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides client functions for interacting with an Ingestion API. It includes functions for fetching plain-text error messages, required ingestion fields, and ingestion results from a backend service, handling different response types accordingly. It uses fetch to make HTTP requests and handles errors to ensure responses are either parsed JSON or plain text, with proper error throwing when needed.

methods.name: apiFetchText(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
methods.description: Reads plain-text responses from the backend, separate from the JSON fetch to handle plain text responses correctly.

methods.name: fetchMockRequiredIngestionFields()
methods.description: Fetches required ingestion fields from a mock endpoint, returning parsed JSON or throwing an error if failed.

methods.name: fetchDateTimeMissingErrorMessage()
methods.description: Fetches a plain-text error message about missing date/time from the backend.

methods.name: fetchIngestionResult({ payload } = {})
methods.description: Attempts to fetch ingestion results via GET, falling back to POST if necessary, returning parsed JSON data.

ctags.signature: (path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
